children: Sterling could fall further against the euro as the latest U.K. inflation data might tilt the Bank of England towards dampening elevated interest-rate rise expectations in a decision Thursday, ING's Francesco Pesole says in a note. Data Wednesday showed inflation accelerated to 3.1% in August, as expected, but core and services inflation were unchanged. That supports the case for the BOE to sound cautious about raising rates, he says. "We still target a return above 0.8600 in euro/sterling in the coming days." The euro rises 0.1% to 0.8570 pounds. (renae.dyer@wsj.com)
